program.name: Starlight Autonomous Product Foundry
program.thesis: Convert proven workflows into verified agent-delivered products without making founder implementation hours the fulfillment model.
program.commercialRule: Sell outcomes, entitlements, service credits, updates, recurring operators, and explicitly agreed partner rights only after the autonomy gate passes.

evidence: Read-only Vercel Agent Runs inspection returned no production projects for the preceding 30 days.
pp preflight --workload swarm returned HOLD because free RAM, CPU load, and Codex runtime count exceeded the swarm contract.

autonomyLevels.name: discovered
autonomyLevels.description: A workflow, bespoke implementation, or concept without repeatable agent fulfillment.

autonomyLevels.name: packaged-assisted
autonomyLevels.description: A skill, plugin, template, or pack exists, but setup or support still depends on expert help.

autonomyLevels.name: agent-delivered-beta
autonomyLevels.description: An agent creates and validates the artifact while a human handles exceptions and studies failures.

autonomyLevels.name: self-serve-commercial
autonomyLevels.description: Checkout or grant through verified first win works without Frank on the happy path.

autonomyLevels.name: autonomous-recurring-operator
autonomyLevels.description: Recurring execution, metering, support, recovery, and renewal are agent-run within policy.

autonomyLevels.name: partner-scale-system
autonomyLevels.description: Multiple operators, attribution, updates, independent verification, and partner governance are proven.

requirements: A second user activates without Frank.
The happy path requires no founder setup or support.
Evaluation, privacy, claims, and security checks pass.
Entitlement grant, revoke, expiry, refund, and recovery are tested.
Agent writes are least-privilege, reversible, and receipted.
Cost estimates, credit caps, settlement, and failed-run behavior are visible.
Support automation resolves known issues and escalates unknown exceptions.
Version, provenance, changelog, update path, and rollback are verified.
Commercial terms and rights have named human approval.

creditEconomy.name: Starlight service credits
accountingRules: Show an estimate and maximum before execution.
Reserve no more than the approved maximum.
Settle actual usage from an append-only ledger.
Release unused reserves after success, failure, or cancellation.
Stop before workspace, time, retry, model, or credit caps are exceeded.
Create a redacted receipt for every settled run.
Do not convert, transfer, trade, or represent credits as money or ownership.

providerAdapters.decision: Candidate for the first developer-native pack or credit-backed agent SKU after sandbox tests.
Candidate for affiliate-led digital products after sandbox, refund, license, and referral tests.
Do not migrate an existing product solely for stack uniformity.

affiliateRules: Use the product's approved merchant affiliate adapter for Starlight product referrals.
Use the Agentic Income network for disclosed third-party recommendations.
Reverify the program and product before public recommendation.
Refunded, fraudulent, and self-referred orders are not commissionable unless provider policy explicitly says otherwise.
Affiliate economics never alter the architecture recommendation.
A reusable IP contribution is evaluated as co-creation, not hidden under an affiliate label.

distributableNetReceipts.startingPoint: settled customer receipts excluding taxes collected for authorities

rules: Background IP stays with the contributing party unless a written license says otherwise.
Private customer or partner material never becomes generic product IP by default.
Disputed attribution or allocation freezes; it never auto-pays.
A proof period does not imply equity or a long-term revenue share.
The agent may calculate and explain an allocation but cannot approve terms or send a payout.
Every royalty, net-receipts share, equity option, public case study, or partner claim is human-gated.
